slides.title: Don't trade tomorrow's *best hour for tonight's *worst one.
Your last hour is your *weakest.
slides.body: Tired emails. Endless scrolling. Half-read docs.

slides.title: Your first hour is your *sharpest.
slides.body: Fresh head. Quiet inbox. No meetings yet.

slides.title: Laptop shuts at a *set time.
slides.body: Pick the time now. Put it in your calendar.

slides.title: The hard task moves to the *morning.
slides.body: Whatever you'd stay up for, do it first thing instead.

slides.title: Protect the *morning.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
